day_shape: 55 items dominated by reports of Trump ordering a new wave of strikes on Iran with MBS urging reconsideration, Iranian threats to Gulf energy sites, IDF strikes in Gaza and south Lebanon, heavy Arbaeen-themed IRIB output, and no UK Parliament or OFAC activity.

threads.label: Trump strike order and Iran response
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump ordered another wave of strikes on Iran to force surrender, while Jerusalem Post reported MBS urged him by phone to reconsider and that Trump also called for an immediate deal. Iranian military officials denied Trump's claim that Tehran asked the US to stop attacks, and Israeli officials were quoted as saying the conflict is 'on the verge of exploding'.

threads.label: Iranian threats to regional energy and US forces
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iranian officials threatened strikes on Israel and regional energy infrastructure, with Khamenei ex-adviser Mohammad Marandi warning Gulf states could face devastating attacks; the outlet also reported Tehran's alleged pursuit of Chinese MANPADS. Regime outlets Defa Press and IRIB claimed Pentagon costs from the '12-day' and Ramadan wars exceeded $150 billion and that US air-defence reserves have been depleted, with a deputy defence minister saying Iran treats US threats as credible.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced destruction of five Hamas weapons depots in Gaza overnight, one adjacent to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, and said it killed Nukhba Force cell head Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad, an October 7 Nir Oz infiltrator. In south Lebanon an IDF officer was moderately wounded in a gunfight on the Ali Taher ridge and Hezbollah gunmen were killed in a follow-up strike.

threads.label: Arbaeen mobilisation on regime channels
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted an Arbaeen message framing the pilgrimage as unifying, while IRIB and Defa Press ran extensive Arbaeen logistics coverage including 699,406 pilgrims through Kermanshah by Saturday, new Ramsar–Najaf flights, and enforcement action against ticket scalping. The cycle ran alongside Bar Association head Abdolianpour's DefaPress claim of over 5 million lawsuits registered against 'America and the Zionist regime'.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure points
threads.summary: Iran International reported the execution of 20-year-old protester Arvin Kheirkhah at Shahroud prison with fears for other detainees, and quoted parliament speaker Ghalibaf saying authorities rushed to announce Khamenei's death after the outlet broke the news to pre-empt street unrest. IRIB separately flagged possible explosion sounds in south Isfahan from planned ordnance disposal.

Soon again the open bosom of the generous Iraqi nation and the warm-blooded tribes and groups and their affection will welcome those eager pilgrims visiting for Arbaeen and among them those visiting by proxy on behalf of martyred Iran, intermingled with the memory of this grand and magnificent funeral procession and magnanimity, those who may have nurtured the wish for years to be privileged to visit the Holy Shrines, and will demonstrate the truth-filled slogan Love of Hussain unites us to all.

events.title: Ghalibaf reveals Tehran feared street unrest after Iran International broke Khamenei news
events.summary: Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said authorities rushed to announce Ali Khamenei’s death and call supporters onto the streets after “overseas media” broke the news, fearing the situation on the streets could otherwise “take a completely different turn.”
